module.name: TreeStorage
module.short: Contains utility routines used to save or load the tree nodes in a tree view control using an XML storage format.

element.name: TTreeItemStorageOption
element.short: Represents the options which determine the tree node values read or written in load and save routines.

descr.p: Values from the enumeration are stored in the TTreeItemStorageOptions set type. When a value is included in the set, the corresponding property in the TTreeNode instance is included in the data processed in the load and save routines. If a value is omitted from the set, the corresponding property in the TTreeNode is ignored.
The enumeration values are used in the TreeSaveToXML and TreeLoadFromXML routines when properties for TTreeNodes are read from or written to an XML storage format.
Use the TTreeItemStorageOptions set type to store values from the TTreeItemStorageOption enumeration.

element.name: TTreeItemStorageOption.tsoExpanded
element.short: Data about a tree node includes the setting in its Expanded property.

element.name: TTreeItemStorageOption.tsoSelected
element.short: Data about a tree node includes the setting in its Selected property.

element.name: TTreeItemStorageOption.tsoFocused
element.short: Data about a tree node includes the setting in its Focused property.

element.name: TTreeItemStorageOption.tsoVisible
element.short: Data about a tree node includes the setting in its Visible property.

element.name: TTreeItemStorageOption.tsoEnabled
element.short: Data about a tree node includes the setting in its Enabled property.

element.name: TTreeItemStorageOption.tsoImageIndex
element.short: Data about a tree node includes the setting in its ImageIndex property.

element.name: TTreeItemStorageOption.tsoSelectedIndex
element.short: Data about a tree node includes the setting in its SelectedIndex property.

element.name: TTreeItemStorageOption.tsoStateIndex
element.short: Data about a tree node includes the setting in its StateIndex property.

element.name: TTreeItemStorageOption.tsoOverlayIndex
element.short: Data about a tree node includes the setting in its OverlayIndex property.

element.name: TTreeItemStorageOptions
element.short: Set type used to store values from the TTreeItemStorageOption enumeration.

descr.p: TTreeItemStorageOptions is a set type used to store zero or more values from the TTreeItemStorageOption enumeration. TTreeItemStorageOptions is the type passed as an argument to routines like TreeSaveToXMl and TreeLoadFromXML. It controls which property values in a TTreeNode instance are read or written in the routines.
See TTreeItemStorageOption for the values in the enumeration and their usage.

element.name: TTreeStorageCallback
element.short: Specifies a callback routine used to perform actions needed when a tree node is read from or written to an XML DOM node.

descr.p: TTreeStorageCallback is an object procedure type which defines a callback used to read or write a tree node to or from an XML DOM node. TTreeStorageCallback allows arbitrary data in the specified tree or XML nodes to be handled properly.
An example usage:

As a save callback, it can be used to convert / format / cast untyped content in the TTreeNode.Data property before it is stored to the specified tree node. As a load callback, the content in an XML node can be converted / formatted / cast before it is stored to the TTreeNode.Data property.

Routines using the TTreeStorageCallback signature are passed as an argument to TreeSaveToXML and TreeLoadFromXML routines. The callback routine is executed for each tree node processed in the tree view. The callback occurs after typed members in TTreeItemStorageOption for a given tree node have been read or written. An application must implement a routine using the signature to perform actions needed.

element.name: TTreeStorageCallback.ATreeNode
element.short: TTreeNode instance used in the routine.

element.name: TTreeStorageCallback.ADomNode
element.short: TDOMNode instance used in the routine.

element.name: TreeItemStorageDefaultOptions
element.short: Set with all of the available TTreeItemStorageOption values.

descr.p: TreeItemStorageDefaultOptions is a set constant which contains all of the values from the TTreeItemStorageOption enumeration. TreeItemStorageDefaultOptions is the default value used for arguments passed to the TreeSaveToXML and TreeLoadFromXML routines. It ensures that all of the relevant properties in a TTreeNode instance are processed in the corresponding routine.

element.name: TreeSaveToXML
element.short: Saves tree nodes found in the specified tree view control using an XML storage format.

descr.p: TreeSaveToXML is an overloaded routine used to write the nodes found in a tree view control to an XML storage format. The overloaded variants allow the XML content to be stored to either a file or a stream.
Tree is the TCustomTreeView control with the tree nodes written in the routine.

Options is a TTreeItemStorageOptions set type which controls the properties in a TTreeNode instance which are written to the XML storage format. The default value for the parameter is TreeItemStorageDefaultOptions and causes all of the relevant properties for a given tree node to be written in the routine. See TTreeItemStorageOption for information about Options values and their meanings.
Use the Fn or St arguments to specify the file name or stream where the XML representation for the hierarchical tree structure is stored.

OnCallback is an optional routine used to format / convert / cast arbitrary data in a tree node when it is written to the specified XML file. OnCallback is called (when assigned) for each TTreeNode instance processed for the tree view control.

TreeSaveToXML creates a TXMLDocument used to store the hierarchy of tree nodes found on the tree view control. The root node is always give the element name "Treeview". The element used to store the hierarchy of tree nodes is given the name "Items". Each tree node is given the element name "Node". The XML content generated in the routine looks like the following:
descr.code: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <Treeview> <Items> <Node Caption="Item0" Expanded="True"> <Node Caption="Item0_0"/> <Node Caption="Item0_1"/> </Node> <Node Caption="Item1" Expanded="True"> <Node Caption="Item1_0"/> <Node Caption="Item1_1"/> </Node> <Node Caption="Item2" Expanded="True"> <Node Caption="Item2_0" Expanded="True"> <Node Caption="Item2_0_0"/> </Node> </Node> <Node Caption="Item3"/> <Node Caption="Item foo bar"/> </Items> </Treeview>
descr.p: The Caption (or Text) for a given tree node is stored as the Caption attribute in the Node element. Values in the Options argument control the other TTreeNode properties which are stored as attributes in Node elements. For example, a node where TTreeNode.Expanded is set will generated an Expanded attribute name and value pair when the property is True and tsoExpanded has been included in the Options argument. The attribute is omitted if the property is False or the storage setting is not included in Options. The same logic applies to other TreeNode property values and the corresponding storage settings in Options. Use the OnCallBack argument to handle untyped data in a TTree node (like the Data property), or any tree node property not explicitly handled using Options.

element.name: TreeSaveToXML.Tree
element.short: TCustomTreeView control with the tree nodes written in the routine.

element.name: TreeSaveToXML.Fn
element.short: Name for the XML file where the hierarchical tree structure is stored.

element.name: TreeSaveToXML.Options
element.short: Options which control the tree node values written in the routine.

element.name: TreeSaveToXML.St
element.short: TStream instance where where the hierarchical tree structure is stored.

element.name: TreeSaveToXML.OnCallback
element.short: Callback routine executed for each tree node written to the specified XML file. Default is Nil.

element.name: TreeLoadFromXML
element.short: Loads tree nodes stored in XML format to the specified tree view control.

descr.p: TreeLoadFromXMl is a an overloaded routine used to load the hierarchical tree nodes stored in the Items property for the specified tree view control from an XML storage format. The overloaded variants allow the XML content to originate from either a file or a stream.
Tree is the TCustomTreeView control where the tree nodes are stored in the routine.

Options is a TTreeItemStorageOptions set type which controls the properties which are stored in TTreeNode instance which are read from the XML storage format. The default value for the parameter is TreeItemStorageDefaultOptions and causes all of the relevant properties for a given tree node to be stored in the routine. See TTreeItemStorageOption for information about Options values and their meanings.
Use the Fn or St arguments to specify the file name or stream where the XML representation for the hierarchical tree structure was stored.

OnCallback is an optional routine used to format / convert / cast arbitrary data in a tree node when it is read from DOM nodes in the specified XML file. OnCallback is called (when assigned) for each TTreeNode instance processed for the tree view control.
TreeLoadFromXML creates a TXMLDocument with the hierarchy of tree nodes found in the file or stream. The XML document contains elements with names like "Treeview", "Items", and "Node". For example:
descr.code: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <Treeview> <Items> <Node Caption="Item0" Expanded="True"> <Node Caption="Item0_0"/> <Node Caption="Item0_1"/> </Node> <Node Caption="Item1" Expanded="True"> <Node Caption="Item1_0"/> <Node Caption="Item1_1"/> </Node> <Node Caption="Item2" Expanded="True"> <Node Caption="Item2_0" Expanded="True"> <Node Caption="Item2_0_0"/> </Node> </Node> <Node Caption="Item3"/> <Node Caption="Item foo bar"/> </Items> </Treeview>
descr.p: TreeLoadFromXML updates the Items property in the tree view control. It clears the Items collection on entry, and adds a TTreeNode to Items for each of the Node elements in the XML content.

The Caption attribute for a Node element is stored as the Text for a given TTreeNode instance. Values in the Options argument control the other TTreeNode properties updated from the attribute values provided in Node elements. For example, when tsoExpanded has been included in Options the value for the Expanded attribute is stored in the Expanded property for the TTreeNode instance. When tsoVisible has been include in Option, the Visible attribute is used to set the value in the Visible property for the TTreeNode instance. Only those values specified in Options are applied to the TTreeNode instances created in the routine; other properties have their default values. Use the OnCallback routine to performs actions needed for untyped property values (like Data) or any tree node property not explicitly supported in Options.

element.name: TreeLoadFromXML.Tree
element.short: TCustomTreeView control where the tree nodes are stored in the routine.

element.name: TreeLoadFromXML.Fn
element.short: Name for the XML file with the tree nodes loaded in the routine.

element.name: TreeLoadFromXML.Options
element.short: Storage options enabled for the tree nodes loaded in the routine.

element.name: TreeLoadFromXML.St
element.short: TStream instance with the XML content loaded in the routine.

element.name: TreeLoadFromXML.OnCallback
element.short: Callback routine executed for each tree node read from the specified XML file. Default is Nil.
